entries.name: TextBlock
entries.purpose: WDS Typography primitive with mobile copy line-breaking, maxLines, and truncation policy.
strain_notes: New fontSize or raw typography in a screen is a vocabulary gap unless TextBlock cannot express the role.

entries.name: Box/Flex/Float/Grid/HStack/VStack
entries.purpose: Layout primitives that constrain spacing to the project semantic spacing vocabulary.
strain_notes: Use sparingly in routes; screen-level rhythm belongs to templates.

entries.name: Divider
strain_notes: Avoid inline divider divs with raw color or margin.

entries.name: Placeholder
entries.purpose: WDS Thumbnail-based placeholder for unresolved image/icon slots.
strain_notes: Replace with real media when the primary task requires product/place inspection.

entries.name: Logo/Status*
strain_notes: General icons should come from WDS icon registry before adding local SVG atoms.
